Category sums: Structural 17/21 · Metadata 19/21 · Technical 20/25 · FAIRness 16/21.

**Applicability.** No question was excluded. The four gated conditions each resolved on fields outside the gated question's own scoring set: sharing is evidenced by the resolvable Dataverse page, publication dates and the statement that all ten archives have public file access (gates Q10, Q12, Q13, Q17); the software condition is met by `external_resources` naming the Cell Mapping Toolkit GitHub/Zenodo repositories and FAIRSCAPE (gates Q11); the human-subjects condition is borderline — human-donor-derived cell lines with donor demographics in `description`/`keywords`/`raw_data_sources`, but no enrolled participants — so under the ambiguity rule Q8 and Q15 are **applicable and scored** (4 and 3) rather than set to N/A.

**Scoring drivers.** Top marks for keyword diversity, narrative length, funding, governance, version/sustainability documentation and citations. The largest deductions: Q4 (2/5 — a single ZIP container media type, though enumeration of ten checksummed archives is excellent), Q20 (3/5 — one bias category, no AIO/CROISSANT mapping, empty `future_use_impacts`), Q11 (3/5 — one packaging-level preprocessing entry, no tool versions), Q15 (3/5 — donor-level demographics but no subpopulation structure).

**Semantic findings** (16 passed / 2 failed / 6 warnings). Two failures: temporal ordering (three IF archives issued 2026-07-15, after the v2.0 publication date of 2026-06-17, plus an unresolved portal/Dataverse 2025-vs-2026 conflict), and an asserted RO-Crate PROV graph that is not instantiated (`was_derived_from` and `parent_datasets` empty; the sole derivation claim inferred from filenames). Validations: DOI prefix 10.18130 registrar-consistent with the UVA Dataverse landing page and citation; NIH numbers `1OT2OD032742-01` and `5U54HG012513-02` well-formed; RRIDs correctly in the Cellosaurus `CVCL_` namespace rather than `SCR_`/`AB_`; URLs structurally valid (not network-resolved). The record's field-level `source_caveats` discipline — including refusing to carry forward protein counts once MD5 checksums diverged — was credited as a genuine strength, not treated as a defect.
